import duckdb,json,hashlib,pathlib,os
c=duckdb.connect(':memory:');c.execute('SET autoinstall_known_extensions=false');c.execute('SET autoload_known_extensions=false');c.execute('LOAD ducklake')
q=c.execute("SELECT * FROM duckdb_extensions() WHERE extension_name IN ('ducklake','parquet')")
rows=[dict(zip([d[0] for d in q.description],row)) for row in q.fetchall()]
for row in rows:
 p=pathlib.Path(row.get('install_path',''))
 if p.is_file():row['sha256']=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();row['bytes']=p.stat().st_size
print(json.dumps(dict(uid=os.geteuid(),gid=os.getegid(),duckdb=duckdb.__version__,extensions=rows),default=str))
